# Gobiya

> Gobiya is a Los Angeles search & digital marketing consulting firm founded in 2010 by Steve Martin (Gobiya LLC since 2012). We recover organic traffic lost to Google algorithm updates and engineer the technical, content, and authority signals that get brands cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. BBB A+ rated; Google Partner 2015–2019.

Contact: hello@gobiya.com · +1-323-744-1338 · 3580 Wilshire Blvd, Ste 132, Los Angeles, CA 90010

## Services

- [Technical & On-Page SEO](https://www.gobiya.com/services/seo): Technical SEO, crawlability, structured data, Core Web Vitals, algorithm recovery
- [AI & GEO Search Optimization](https://www.gobiya.com/services/geo): Generative Engine Optimization engineered to be cited in AI-generated answers
- [Content Marketing & Strategy](https://www.gobiya.com/services/content-marketing): Data-driven content, topic hubs, search-intent writing
- [Digital PR & Link Building](https://www.gobiya.com/services/link-building): Editorial link acquisition, brand citations, and authority building
- [PPC & Google Ads Management](https://www.gobiya.com/services/ppc): Google Ads, paid search management, and cost-per-lead optimization
- [CRO & UX Analysis](https://www.gobiya.com/services/cro): Conversion rate optimization, A/B testing, and user experience friction reduction
- [Web & App Development](https://www.gobiya.com/services/web-dev): Next.js/React websites built SEO-ready from day one
- [AI & LLM Systems Consulting](https://www.gobiya.com/services/ai-consulting): Practical AI integration, llms.txt setup, and custom LLM workflows
- [All Services](https://www.gobiya.com/services)
